audit.why: Ranged poke laner vs a melee drain-tank: Akshan owns levels 1-2 before Infernal Chains (W) exists, the lane goes coin-flip at 3, and Aatrox takes over once drain items land. Existing difficulty 4/10 and the content whys already describe exactly this and agree with the mirror audit aatrox__akshan.json.

audit.whatIsWrong: The FULL layer's Level 6 / first item / 2+ item phases all claim Akshan keeps a 7/10 edge, and never cite a cooldown. The content layer's own whys say the opposite from first item onward.
audit.why: World Ender is 120/100/80s and grants increased healing plus stealth reveal; Comeuppance is 100/85/70 at 2500 range. Aatrox's spike is his ult plus drain items, Akshan's is Comeuppance and lethality — the FULL phases contradicted the content whys.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is even (Comeuppance 100s execute vs World Ender's stealth reveal); first item and 2+ items go to Aatrox's healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The FULL layer never names a single Aatrox ability and never states the decisive interaction: World Ender reveals stealth, which turns off Going Rogue (W).
audit.why: Riot's World Ender text plus the derived revealsStealth flag: while it runs, Akshan's camouflage does not hide him. Heroic Swing (E, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12) requires terrain to anchor, so Aatrox fighting Akshan away from walls removes the escape. Infernal Chains (W, 20/18/16/14/12) drags a champion back to the impact centre if they do not leave it, and Umbral Dash (E) is only 9/8/7/6/5 so swinging in is not an escape. Deathbringer Stance heals off target max health, so extended trades favour him.
audit.corrected: World Ender (120/100/80) reveals stealth — Going Rogue is not an exit while it runs; hug terrain so Heroic Swing has an anchor, and bait Infernal Chains (20s) before you commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown text gave no numbers at all.
audit.why: World Ender 120/100/80 and Infernal Chains 20/18/16/14/12 are the two punishable windows.
audit.corrected: Named both cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns and report[9].

audit.why: Existing itemization already calls for early anti-heal, which matches the needs-antiheal flag for Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender.

edits.before: Comeuppance online — the lock-on execute closes everything you chip. Scoundrels die; teammates revive.
edits.after: Comeuppance (100s) executes from 2500 range, but World Ender reveals stealth — Going Rogue is no exit at 6.

edits.before: First item spike — the swing-fire pattern now removes half bars. Take over the lane and start roaming for revives.
edits.after: His drain items and World Ender lifesteal out-heal your chip now — take plates and roam; do not restart the brawl.

edits.before: Crit items even out the field — your edge stays the map game: revives, executes, and swings nobody wards.
edits.after: Deathbringer Stance heals off your max HP every few autos — win on picks and Comeuppance, never a sustained duel.

edits.before: - Aatrox World Ender: matchup-defining — His drain-tank mode — never take a long fight into it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E swing like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Aatrox World Ender: 120/100/80s and it reveals stealth — no long fight into it, and no Going Rogue exit while it runs. - Infernal Chains is 20s at rank 1: bait the drag, then Heroic Swing off a wall. - R goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Aatrox whiffs World Ender and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: World Ender reveals your W camo — terrain, not stealth, is the exit.

edits.before: The swing has one interrupt answer — using E as an entrance instead of an exit hands him that answer for free.
edits.after: Infernal Chains (W, 20s) drags you back to its centre — E in and Umbral Dash (E, 9s) keeps him on top of you.

edits.before: Track Aatrox’s World Ender: His drain-tank mode — never take a long fight into it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: World Ender (120s) reveals stealth, so Going Rogue hides nothing while it burns; Infernal Chains drags you back to its centre.

edits.before: Commit on World Ender’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit while World Ender is down — 120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3 — on your first item, and with jungle setup. His answer goes first.
